COMPLICATIONS OF TETANUS
Complications
- Autonomic dysfunction
- Labile or sustained hypertension
- Tachycardia
- Dysarrhythmias
- Hyperpyrexia
- Profuse sweating
- Peripheral vasoconstriction
- Cardiac arrest
- Aspiration pneumonia
- Fractures
- Muscle rupture
- Deep vein thrombophlebitis
- Pulmonary emboli
- Decubitus ulcers
- Rhabdomyolysis
